title: Working Together
description: Plot: Team strategy and preparation for restoring the Rainbow Crystal | Emotion: Friendship triumph and collaborative strength, healing begins | Setting: Crystal Caves chamber, now clearing of dark magic at Immediately following the Shadow Weaver's choice to accept help | Characters: Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, Headmistress Aurora, All unicorn partners, Obsidian (formerly Shadow Weaver)
lyrics:
I used to think that leadership
Meant having all the answers
I used to think that being strong
Meant never showing doubt

But watching you with all your books
And all your careful research
Has taught me there's another way
To figure problems out

You take the time to understand
Before you make a plan
You ask the questions I don't think to ask
You see what I can't see

I used to think that being smart
Meant knowing every fact
I used to think that being right
Was all that really mattered

But watching you bring people together
And help them find their way
Has taught me that real wisdom
Is more than what books say

You make things happen in the world
While I just think and read
You turn ideas into action
You do what people need

We're different but the same
We're different but the same
We both want to help and heal and grow
We just take different roads

We're different but the same
We're different but the same
And when we work together
There's nothing we can't know

Your strength makes me stronger
My knowledge helps you lead
We're different but the same
And that's exactly what we need

LUNA:
I was scared and felt alone

OBSIDIAN:
I was angry and felt cast out

AURORA:
I was trying to protect

ALL THREE:
But we all had the same doubt

That we weren't good enough
That we didn't quite belong
But together we're discovering
We were never really wrong

ALL:
We're different but the same
We're different but the same
We all want to love and learn and grow
We just take different roads

We're different but the same
We're different but the same
And when we work together
There's nothing we can't know

RUBY & SAGE:
Your strength makes me stronger

LUNA & OBSIDIAN:
Your courage helps me heal

AURORA & UNICORNS:
Your wisdom guides us forward

ALL:
And makes everything feel real

We're different but the same
We're different but the same
And that's exactly what we need
To make our dreams come true

We're different but the same
We're different but the same
And there's nothing we can't do
When we're me and when we're you
stage_directions: Character Development. The crystal chamber is transforming as the dark magic dissipates. The corrupted formations are slowly returning to their natural rainbow colors, and the stolen Rainbow Crystal, while still trapped, is beginning to pulse with its true light.. The space now feels like a place of healing rather than a villain's lair. Ancient crystal formations create natural seating areas, and the magical energy feels supportive rather than threatening. It's becoming a place where different people can come together and find common ground.
character_notes:
The crystal chamber is transforming as the dark magic dissipates. The corrupted formations are slowly returning to their natural rainbow colors, and the stolen Rainbow Crystal, while still trapped, is beginning to pulse with its true light.

The space now feels like a place of healing rather than a villain's lair. Ancient crystal formations create natural seating areas, and the magical energy feels supportive rather than threatening. It's becoming a place where different people can come together and find common ground.
